dimensions.name: responsibility-ownership
dimensions.evidence: Model/fusion, collection, dataset persistence, and training/checkpoint lifecycle have separate owner modules; scripts only compose them.

dimensions.name: public-interface
dimensions.evidence: Validated dataclasses expose Support, Query, pair identity, command equality, latent shape, and first-action loss without simulator-private access.

dimensions.name: dependency-direction
dimensions.evidence: Context owners depend on public FADA Planner-IDM APIs; the only source-owner addition is a checkpoint-compatible encode_latent/decode_latent split.

dimensions.name: state-lifecycle
dimensions.evidence: Collector disables autoreset, rejects terminated/command-changing pairs, uses independent resets, and closes the environment; optimizer owns only Context.

dimensions.name: change-surface
dimensions.evidence: Nominal FADA forward/state_dict behavior is pinned by exact latent equivalence and 49 focused/regression tests.

dimensions.name: evidence-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Runtime evidence claims only collection, nonzero action loss, gradient connectivity, one-step update and persistence; formal training and closed-loop quality remain pending.

dimensions.name: tensor-provenance
dimensions.evidence: Support target/realized/action, Query history/intent/realized/action, command, pair IDs, dtype/device, finite values and H/K axes fail closed; Query never enters Context forward.

dimensions.name: gradient-update-boundary
dimensions.evidence: Tests and MuJoCo preflight show positive finite Context gradients, first-action-only loss, zero Planner/IDM gradients, and no frozen parameter mutation.

dimensions.name: persistence-evaluation
dimensions.evidence: Dataset and Context checkpoints are versioned and strict-bind architecture, support length, healthy SHA, context config, optimizer state, split seed and metrics.

evidence.observation: Initial implementation validated dtype/device only within Support and Query, not across the complete batch.
Cross-object dtype mismatch now fails closed.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: The complete Support-Query tensor transaction could reach model execution with inconsistent dtype/device.
findings.preserved_behavior: Valid same-device/same-dtype batches retain identical behavior.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Validate Support, Query, and support_command dtype/device at the aggregate batch boundary.
findings.stop_condition: Resolved when aggregate validation and focused regression pass.

evidence.observation: Initial strict load could mutate Context before a later optimizer-state load failure.
Context and optimizer state now roll back exactly after a corrupt optimizer-state failure.

findings.responsibility_at_risk: Checkpoint restoration could leave a partially committed training state after failure.
findings.preserved_behavior: Valid strict checkpoint loads restore the same Context and optional optimizer state.
findings.smallest_safe_change: Snapshot Context and optimizer state, load both inside one transaction, and restore both on any exception.
required_tests: Corrupt optimizer-state load leaves Context and optimizer unchanged
findings.stop_condition: Resolved when failure rollback is exact and the full focused suite passes.

residual_risks: The one-step smoke run is not a formal training result; held-out Query action improvement over the full dataset remains unverified.
No post-training fixed-delta MuJoCo re-execution has tested whether lower action MSE improves trajectory tracking.
A fixed left-knee 0.7 campaign can learn a constant calibration and cannot establish cross-fault identification or generalization.
